data.name: iGNITION 2000: Origins
data.detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in the world of street racing, go on an adventure on those 2000s summer nights!
Take care of your ride, upgrade it, customize it! Unlock and explore cars never seen before, discover new roads, take up new challenges! Or just go on a relaxing night run, it's up to you!

WARNING: Only 1 car and 1 map available in the current version!!

FEATURES

  • Late Night Touge Roads
    Test your ride limits on those tight and twisty mountain roads, find the right opportunity to overtake your rival... or just go on a relaxing night run, it's up to you!

  • 2000s Tuners Customization
    Enjoy the golden age of automobile customization: change bumpers, tailights, hoods, add some neons, stickers... you name it! Here cars are like a blank canvas waiting for your unique touch!

  • Intense Challenges
    Aggressive yet precise Racers will push beyond your limits, NPC logic is tuned to the max! Explore the many available types of events, ranging from Sprint, Eliminator, Circuit, Timetrial, NightRun... (and more to come!)

  • Level Based Progression
    Choose which event to join and jump straight into action! Beat events to unlock more car parts, more events, and even shop types! World areas are still free to explore through the NightRun mode, which you can use it for pratice or just enjoy the scenery.

  • MP3 Import (BETA)
    If you want custom music, you can choose and import your favorite tracks and make it play inside the game during races! (music folder currently limited to 150mb max)

  • Photomode
    Use the PhotoMode to capture any moment, stop the time, pop out the camera, shoot, you got photo! :D
    Rendering resolution up to 8K when using 720p screen resolution.

  • Optimized Graphics
    Made to run and look good even on potato PCs! (stable 60FPS at 720p)
    Featuring optimized realtime reflections with near zero performance impact.

  • Crossplatform Cloud Sync
    Specially useful if you have a portable handheld like the SteamDeck. So you can freely switch between devices that use Steam, and everytime you boot the game, everything will stay as you have left it!

DEVELOPER'S NOTE
This is an early version of a game made by a solo developer.
For now, content is limited aaaand there might be a few bugs...
I'm working on cool new stuff for future updates!
So yeah, stay tuned! :D

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 7200U
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 720p60 Low Graphics. When in doubt, try the demo out!

Minimum:

  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel i5 7200U
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or Intel UHD 770
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 720p60 Low Graphics. When in doubt, try the demo out!
